question: Should repair apply and post-flight writes fail closed whenever reviewed activity, target or covering-PR state, required checks, mutation outcome, or state credentials cannot be re-proven at the final request boundary?
rationale: The branch deliberately trades repair availability during uncertain or drifting state for stronger protection against stale authoritative mutations, so repository-owner intent is required.

options.title: Approve fail-closed boundary
options.body: Merge the exact reviewed head after staged proof demonstrates both stale-state rejection and successful fresh-state completion.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Land the final mutation guards first and defer receipt or credential-publication changes to reduce the initial operational blast radius.

options.title: Preserve current availability
options.body: Keep the branch unmerged until maintainers define a less fail-closed mutation contract.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed boundary
recommendation.body: Merge the exact reviewed head after staged proof demonstrates both stale-state rejection and successful fresh-state completion.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged and current-head history identifies this person as the owner of the review-freshness foundation and repair-boundary extension.
